ORDINANCE IV OF 2005
SINDH COTTON CONTROL
(AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2005
An Ordinance to amend
the Sindh Cotton
Control Ordinance, 1966
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part I,
20th May, 2005]
No.S.LEGIS:1(4)/2005, dated 20-5-2005.---The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is hereby published for general Information:-
Preamble.---Whereas it is expedient to amend the Sindh Cotton Control Ordinance, 1966 in the manner
hereinafter appearing;
And whereas the Provincial Assembly is
not in session and the Governor of Sindh is satisfied
that circumstances exist which render it necessary to take immediate action;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers
conferred by clause (I) of Article 128 of the Constitution of the Islamic
Republic of Pakistan, the Governor of Sindh is
pleased to make and promulgate the following Ordinance:-
1. Short title and commencement.---(1) This Ordinance may be called the Sindh Cotton Control (Amendment) Ordinance, 2005.
(2) It shall come into force at once.

Amendment of section 13 of West Pakistan Ordinance XX of 1966

No.S.LEGIS:1(4)/2005, dated 20-5-2005.---The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is hereby published for general Information:-
Preamble.---Whereas it is expedient to amend the Sindh Cotton Control Ordinance, 1966 in the manner
hereinafter appearing;
And whereas the Provincial Assembly is
not in session and the Governor of Sindh is satisfied
that circumstances exist which render it necessary to take immediate action;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers
conferred by clause (I) of Article 128 of the Constitution of the Islamic
Republic of Pakistan, the Governor of Sindh is
pleased to make and promulgate the following Ordinance:-
2. Amendment of section 13 of West Pakistan Ordinance XX of 1966.---In
the Sindh Cotton Control Ordinance, 1966, in section
13---
(i) in subsection (1), for the word "mark", the words
"grade and staple length" shall be substituted; and
(ii) in
subsection (3), for the words "one month", the words "three
months" and for the word "fifty", the words "ten
thousand" shall be substituted.
